# By Hamdi

> By Hamdi is the one-person AI product studio of Hamdi Mohamud Hassan, based in Minnesota. Hamdi builds useful AI-powered products, shares the build-learn-share process publicly, and offers hands-on help to people building products with AI.

Canonical website: https://byhamdi.com

## Hamdi Mohamud Hassan

Hamdi Mohamud Hassan is the founder and builder behind By Hamdi. Public profiles may also use the names Hamdi Hassan, Hamdi Mohamud, or Hamdi.

Profiles:
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/hamdi-hassan-ai/
- GitHub: https://github.com/hamdi2008
- X: https://x.com/hamdimahmuud
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@hamdimohamud08

## Vibe Coding Help Session

By Hamdi offers a 1-on-1 Vibe Coding Help Session for people who have already started building something with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or another AI tool and are stuck on a specific blocker or what comes next.

The session is hands-on and focused on working through a specific problem. Common blockers include getting a prototype out of an AI tool, deploying a product, fixing a feature or setup that is not working, connecting services or integrations, and deciding what the product needs next.

- Provider: Hamdi Mohamud Hassan / By Hamdi
- Price: $99 USD
- Length: 60–90 minutes
- Delivery: 1-on-1, online
- Service page: https://byhamdi.com/vibe-coding-help
- Structured service API: https://byhamdi.com/api/v1/services/vibe-coding-help
- Request process: The user submits their project and blocker first. Hamdi reviews the request for fit before anything is scheduled. Submitting a request does not charge or book the user.

### Agent and API access

AI agents and other clients can retrieve the current public Vibe Coding Help Session details as structured JSON from:
https://byhamdi.com/api/v1/services/vibe-coding-help

Use the structured API when programmatic service details are needed. Use the service page when directing a person to learn more or request help.

## Products

### Life in Views
A personal life-planning app for organizing priorities across Today, Week, Month, Year, and Long-Term views, with measurements and recaps.
https://lifeinviews.com

### MNMuslim
A digital home for Muslims in Minnesota, including local services and events.
https://www.mnmuslim.com/

### MNHalal
A directory for finding halal restaurants, cafes, bakeries, markets, food trucks, and other halal food options in Minnesota.
https://www.mnhalal.com/

### MN Somali
A public reference site compiling reliable information and source links about Somali Minnesotans.
https://www.mnsomalis.com/
